microSkill: simplify a ratio to its simplest form
objectiveWording: Simplify a two- or three-part ratio of positive integers to its simplest form by dividing every part by their greatest common divisor.
successCriteria: Finds the greatest common divisor of the parts.
Divides every part by the gcd.
States the ratio in simplest form with the parts in the given order.

microSkill: write a ratio in simplest form from two or three given quantities
objectiveWording: Write a ratio in simplest form from two or three given quantities, keeping the parts in the stated order.
successCriteria: Reads the given quantities in order.
Forms the ratio of the quantities.
Simplifies to simplest form, preserving order.

subtopic: ratio to fraction of the whole
microSkill: express one part of a ratio as a fraction of the whole
objectiveWording: Express a named part of a two-part ratio as a fraction of the whole, giving an exact fraction in simplest form.
successCriteria: Adds the parts to find the total number of parts.
Writes the named part over the total.
Gives the exact fraction in simplest form.

subtopic: fraction of the whole to ratio
microSkill: write the ratio of a part to the rest from a fraction of the whole
objectiveWording: From a fraction of a whole, write the ratio of that part to the remaining part in simplest form.
successCriteria: Reads the fraction of the whole.
Finds the remaining fraction.
Writes the part-to-rest ratio in simplest form.

microSkill: share a quantity between two shares in a given ratio
objectiveWording: Share a whole quantity between two labelled shares in a given two-part ratio, giving each exact integer share.
successCriteria: Adds the parts to find the total number of parts.
Finds the value of one part by exact division.
Multiplies to give each labelled share and checks the shares sum to the whole.

microSkill: share a quantity between three shares in a given ratio
objectiveWording: Share a whole quantity between three labelled shares in a given three-part ratio, giving each exact integer share.
successCriteria: Adds the three parts to find the total number of parts.
Finds the value of one part by exact division.
Multiplies to give each labelled share and checks the three shares sum to the whole.

subtopic: missing part from a known part
microSkill: find a missing part when one part and the ratio are known
objectiveWording: Find a missing part of a quantity shared in a known ratio, given the value of one part, using exact integer arithmetic.
successCriteria: Identifies the known part and its ratio value.
Finds the value of one part by exact division (the known value is divisible by its ratio part).
Multiplies to give the missing part.

subtopic: direct proportion by the unitary method
microSkill: solve a direct-proportion problem using the unitary method
objectiveWording: Solve a direct-proportion problem by the unitary method, giving an exact value (an integer when the result is whole, otherwise an exact fraction).
successCriteria: Finds the value of one unit by exact division.
Multiplies by the required quantity.
Gives the exact result (integer when whole, else exact fraction).

subtopic: inverse proportion by the unitary method
microSkill: solve a simple integer inverse-proportion problem
objectiveWording: Solve a simple inverse-proportion problem by the unitary method in cases with an exact integer result, using the product invariant.
successCriteria: Recognises the inverse relationship (more of one means less of the other).
Uses the product invariant q1 x v1 = q2 x v2.
Gives the exact integer result.

microSkill: find a unit rate from a total and a quantity
objectiveWording: Find a unit rate (amount per one unit) from a total and a quantity, giving an exact value (an integer when whole, otherwise an exact fraction).
successCriteria: Identifies the total and the number of units.
Divides exactly to find the amount per one unit.
Gives the exact unit rate.

microSkill: compare options by unit rate to identify the best value
objectiveWording: Compare two or three labelled options by their exact unit rates and select the best-value option (no currency conversion).
successCriteria: Computes the exact unit rate of each option.
Compares the exact rates.
Selects the option with the strict minimum unit rate.

microSkill: apply a simple scale factor or map/model scale to find a scaled value
objectiveWording: Apply a simple scale factor (or a map/model scale given as a ratio) to find a scaled numerical value, using exact arithmetic and no measurement.
successCriteria: Identifies the scale and the direction of scaling.
Multiplies or divides exactly by the scale factor.
Gives the exact scaled value (integer when whole, else exact fraction).
